## Goal
Add the agent-facing memory API on top of `OpenBrainClient`.

## Sequencing
Depends on #67. Build this only after `OpenBrainClient` has proven the real MCP-over-HTTP call shape, auth, namespace headers, error handling, and fake transport tests.

## Package path
`python/openbrain-memory/src/openbrain_memory/agent.py`

## Required API
- `AgentMemory(client, agent, project=None, policy=None, spool=None)`
- `start_session(conversation_key, **metadata)`
- `recall(query, *, limit=None, include_decisions=True, include_facts=True)`
- `append_event(role, content, **metadata)`
- `remember_fact(text, **metadata)`
- `remember_decision(text, **metadata)`
- `checkpoint(summary, **metadata)`
- `wrap_session(summary=None, **metadata)`

## Behavior
- Keep Hermes-specific lifecycle names out of this package.
- Support Discord/channel/thread style conversation keys without assuming Discord is the only runtime.
- Return bounded context objects suitable for prompt injection.
- Use client wrappers rather than duplicating protocol details.
- Do not reimplement MCP request/session/auth handling here.

## Tests
- Fake client records method calls.
- Verify fact writes route to thought/memory write semantics.
- Verify decision writes route to decision logging semantics.
- Verify recall assembles bounded context.
- Verify checkpoint/wrap call expected session tools.

## Acceptance criteria
- Public facade matches README quickstart.
- Tests pass without network.
- No Hermes plugin code in this issue.
- Implementation depends on the #67 client API instead of speculative protocol shapes.
